spec.description:
Autex Vicinity Desk Screen - Crest is an elegant, lightweight acoustic desk
divider designed to provide acoustic and visual privacy in open-plan workspaces.
Featuring a curved, crest-like wave profile, Crest fixes non-destructively to
desks using dedicated Vicinity Desk Clamps. Made from 100% polyester fibre with
an 80% recycled PET core, it absorbs sound at the source (0.70 Sabins per unit)
and complies with Group 1 fire safety standards.

install:
Unpack Vicinity Crest panels and inspect
components

Slide Vicinity Workstation Clamps into pre-cut sockets along the
bottom edge of the screen

Position the screen assembly along the edge of the
desk at desired location

Tighten the clamp mounting bolts from the underside
using an Allen key until firmly clamped to desktop

Check screen is upright
and stable without over-tightening
selection_checklist:
Verify desk top thickness and edge
overhang accommodate Vicinity Clamps

Select colour from Autex Cube palette
(20+ colours)

Confirm pack quantity (supplied in packs of 4 screens, 2 pieces
per screen)
Ensure space layout supports curved Crest profile
limitations: Indoor use only; avoid wet areas or direct liquid contact

Clamp requires a
solid desk edge with adequate overhang

Product has a directional grain;
maintain consistent orientation

use_cases:
Dividing facing desks in commercial open-plan offices to
mitigate conversational distractions

Providing personal acoustic shelter and
visual privacy in co-working spaces

Creating pinnable, sound-absorbing
barriers in university computer labs and study halls

floor standing partition without feet or frame
retrieval.rag_summary:
Autex Vicinity Desk Screen -
Crest is a lightweight 12mm acoustic desk screen featuring a gentle curved crest
profile, designed to clamp non-destructively to 1600mm workstations. Made
from 100% polyester fibre with an 80% recycled PET core, it absorbs
conversational noise at the source (0.70 Sabins per unit) while providing a
pinnable self-healing noticeboard. Achieving Group 1 fire compliance under AS
ISO 9705 and certified carbon neutral, Crest delivers acoustic comfort and
visual privacy for modern agile offices.
